title: Heated square plate on growing meshes: multigrid-preconditioned CG (2D Poisson series, analytic)
description:
A square plate (side a, conductivity k) with a uniform heat_source Q and all four faces held at T_wall: -k lap(T) = Q, a genuinely 2D problem. The linear solver is a pcg node with preconditioner 'multigrid' (smoothed-aggregation algebraic multigrid V-cycles). The sweep refines the mesh, N = a / dx in {101, 201, 401, 801} (odd, so the plate centre is a cell centre; up to 6.4e5 cells).
What to look at: the CG iterations per solve stay roughly constant (typically 10-40) while N grows 8x; Jacobi-PCG would need ~10 per cell along the axis (~8000 at N = 801). The counts are in the run's summary.json, solvers -> heat -> roles -> linear -> counters (cg_iterations, multigrid_levels); set the 'mg' node's preconditioner to jacobi to compare.
Analytic: theta = T - T_wall = (Q / (2 k)) [x (a - x) - (8 a^2 / pi^3) sum_{n odd} sin(n pi x / a) cosh(n pi (y - a/2) / a) / (n^3 cosh(n pi / 2))] (n = 1..7 kept); theta_centre = 0.073671 Q a^2 / k; area mean theta = 0.035144 Q a^2 / k (series in tanh(n pi / 2) / n^5 with (31/32) zeta(5)).
Derived values tab: theta_centre (probe at the plate centre) and theta_mean (mean of T - T_wall); second order in dx: expect ~1e-4 (centre) and ~3e-4 (mean) at N = 101, about 4x smaller per refinement.
Sweep tab: theta_centre vs N with the dashed analytic value.
Line profile tab (N = 801): theta_mid_line (field T_rise) along y = a/2 against the series, ~1e-4 of the rise.
